sourceRefs.locator: Antiquity 97, pp. 1233–1248. Introduction, Classification and chronology, Results, Discussion and figs. 2–3. Type 5 sample of 49, 42 certain and 2 probable reindeer identifications. About 0.5% of identifiable workshop waste was reindeer. Trade in finished items and movement of personal possessions are both possibilities. Fig. 3 credits the photographs of four groups to Mariana Muñoz-Rodriguez.
“Koordinate WGS84” gives 54.49104°N, 9.56623°E for the settlement. General orientation for the finds from different places plotted in Muñoz-Rodriguez et al., fig. 2.

note.de: Die in Haithabu gefundenen Kämme eines frühwikingerzeitlichen Typs bestehen in der untersuchten Auswahl meist aus Rentiergeweih. Die Karte zeigt die Siedlung, in der die Stücke gefunden wurden.
note.en: Most of the sampled combs of an early Viking Age type from Hedeby are made of reindeer antler. The map marks the settlement where they were found.
